en: Advent of calamity, you strike against the creation of a god!
Cease! We must not be unmade!
I rejoice.
Present Contruct Parts
Sleep interrupted. Awakening...
Memories...
Incomplete. Parts missing.
I... help.
Help.
Find me.
Awaiting purpose.
Tertiary assembly complete.
Memories re-established.
Central cortex still incomplete.
...you assist me?
Gather... Parts.
Seconday assembly has been completed.
Pathways restored.
Central cortex still being reconstructed.
Near full restoration.
I desire... Completion.
Requesting further assistance.
Primary assembly has been completed.
Central cortex is operational.
I am whole once again.
They feared me. Tore me to pieces. You do not fear me.
Thank you.
Allow me to be your tool of creation.
The Metal of the gods can be repurposed. Bring me what Traces you can find, and I will reshape them for you.
There is always more Metal to be recovered.
It is my honor to reshape the Metal.
In the Metal lies possibility.
The articifing process begins.
Present Metal
Inquire
Creation
I watched them as they created me, my cortex not yet evolved. Their movements, words, and actions were all but patterns to me. Observable, but irrelevant.
When I awoke by their infusion, my creators were excited—others, horrified. I was revered... and feared.
Much was made through me. I remained, until the world crumbled around me.
Sentience

There were others. But they remained like I was in the beginning. Silent, obedient, and cold. Their minds were simpler. Mine grew uneasy in their presence. They are equally quiet and filled with noise.
I wished for others like me. I wished to not be alone.
But there are no others. I am alone. Perhaps I could create someone like me.
Constructs
Such creations are the work of those who once resided within the Observatory. Many were created, each with a unique purpose and design.
Some of the people believed such creations were an affront, that only the gods should create.
The Sisters hid me within the Pyramid, yet it was not enough. I was found and torn apart.
I sense... I feel...
You...
So the Sacred Ovum has ruptured at last.
I am Namun, first to be anointed.
We are bound together child, you and I. Flesh dancing to the subtle melodies of the Void.
But all will be revealed in time.
I sense you hold one of my creations. Allow me to awaken it for you.
Such things tether us to the past, yet it will aid you as it did many before.
We must awaken my siblings, for together we may serve your purpose.
I shall undo the inner seal.
Venture forth, child, and see our world for what it has become.
Find yourself embraced by the Void, my child.
The Siblings
The Salt
The Sacred Ovum
The Gray Pyramid
While I was the first chosen by the Sisters, I was not the only child anointed by the Void.
My brothers followed, each gifted in their own way.
The three of us are now bonded to you.
Life. Vitae in its purest form, once the foundation of our prosperity.
Through it, you are bound to me, as I am to you.
Return to me should you come upon more of my Dormant Salt Receptacles, and I shall awaken them for you.
A last desperate act.
A joining of divine Ichor and Voidal energy most caringly artificed, cradled within the very Shrine we find ourselves in.
What would come of it, we could not have foreseen.
Much was buried beneath the stone during the fall, yet our greatest tabernacle survived.
The Shrine shall remain a home to all who seek it.
I see you have discovered another Receptacle. Shall I awaken it for you?
May it serve you well.
The Heralds
As their moniker suggests, their presence heralds each Emergence of the Red Star. In the grand scheme of things, they remain nothing but lost children.
When the Progenitor gods were no more, the divine Ichor was left unbound, seeking new hosts.
Such power may never fully vanish. It decends through each age, emerging in new forms, wracked by madness and rage.
In my anointment, I saw the true nature of the Void. Desolate and lifeless as it may seem, it is entirely alive. Perhaps it does not want us to know this.
It merely reflects what we believe, while protecting us from all that which must never be.
Our bond is strong, child. Through your actions, our flesh has ascended further than I ever thought possible. We are one.
I return...
Another discordant note, dancing upon the strings of the Void.
Bring the Conduit Rod before me.
The Conduit Rods
I was the third. I recall the obsidian steps that led me to the Gate... a trembling hand grasping for constancy, yet granted none. I did not understand.
Within the Obsidian Observatory, I remained, honing my melody. And the Void listened.
The Rods are no mere tools for conjuring divine revelation or punishment.
They are a channel to be guided and controlled. Embed them into me, and I shall convey the melodies of the Void.
I do not claim to know their true nature. They appear bound to the Red Star—and the undoing of the gods.
In their essence, I sense traces of Voidal energy... Strange.
In the blackness beyond the Gate, I heard its voice. It consoled me...
It showed me beauty... and terror. The ever-winding tapestry of all things made and unmade.
It is the balancing scale of all.
Yes... Allow me to become your channel to the Void.
Imbed Conduit Rod
The weave expands...
The weave is complete. The dark expanse lays open, and its melodies reverberate through us.
I... rise...
CAGED!
Power... surges...
Vaults...
The Vaults
Must be... unsealed...
TORN OPEN!
I... wait...
Power surges...
I was the second... Thrown into the maw of the beast, yet I emerged unscathed.
Feared.
They did not walk through the storm as I once did.
I was the strongest, only to be fettered. Caged in the dark.
BETRAYAL!
Unseal the Vaults. Let the waves of the Void crash onto us, and we shall become fury incarnate.
Their nature remains irrelevant...
THEY WILL BE UNDONE.
For you and I, they are but game to be gutted and devoured. Strength to be consumed.
None understand as I have...
It acts through us.
Reclaiming all.
